headerDisplay: Local BLE control for a PitPat treadmill. Remote motor start is disabled by default. Configure the stable BLE identifier shown in the Homebridge logs.
footerDisplay: The Bluetooth STOP command is not a certified emergency stop. Keep the physical safety control accessible.

deviceIdentifier.title: BLE Device Identifier
deviceIdentifier.description: CoreBluetooth UUID on macOS or BLE address/adapter identifier on Linux. Use the identifier reported by the discovery log.

maximumSpeedKph.title: Maximum Allowed Speed
maximumSpeedKph.description: Safety cap in km/h. The lower of this value and the limit reported by the treadmill is used.

debug.title: Debug Logging
debug.description: Log rate-limited protocol details. Serial-number bytes are redacted.

allowRemoteStart.title: Allow Remote Motor Start
allowRemoteStart.description: DANGEROUS: permits HomeKit, Siri and automations to start the belt. Leave disabled unless hardware validation has been completed.

acknowledgeRemoteStartRisk.title: I Accept the Remote Start Risk
acknowledgeRemoteStartRisk.description: Must also be enabled before remote start is accepted. HomeKit cannot distinguish a manual action from an automation.
